const srcEntries = listDir("src")
  .filter(e => e.kind === "file")
  .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

const lines: string[] = [];
for (const entry of srcEntries) {
  const fileRead = readFile(`src/${entry.name}`);
  const lineCount = fileRead.kind === "text" ? fileRead.totalLines : 0;
  lines.push(`- ${entry.name} (${lineCount} lines)`);
}

const manifestContent = lines.join("\n") + "\n";
writeFile("MANIFEST.md", manifestContent);

const lsOutput = shell("ls -la");
const manifestRead = readTextFile("MANIFEST.md");

console.log("MANIFEST.md contents:\n" + manifestRead);
console.log("ls -la output:\n" + lsOutput.output);

if (lsOutput.output.includes("MANIFEST.md")) {
  finish("Created MANIFEST.md listing all files under src/ with line counts sorted by name, and verified its existence with ls -la.");
} else {
  return { error: "MANIFEST.md not found in ls -la output" };
}

- game.ts (12 lines)
- index.ts (5 lines)
